s: land animals (Chapter 11 dietary rules) must be distinguished (Israel is to make the distinction)
q: You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean.

s: commandments, statutes and ordinances must be kept (by Israel)
q: You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them

s: the LORD sanctifies children of Israel
q: I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

s: the LORD separates children of Israel (from the peoples)
q: I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

s: the LORD is holy
q: for I, the LORD, am holy

s: children of Israel inherits land (land given to Israel) (given by the LORD)
q: You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it

s: children of Israel is commanded to be holy (set apart to be the LORD's)
q: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

s: children of Israel must not follow nation being cast out (its customs)
q: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you

s: child sacrifice to Molech is punished by death (stoning by the people of the land)
q: who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

s: meal offering is made of fine flour (basic offering)
q: his offering shall be of fine flour.

s: meal offering is seasoned with salt (every meal offering)
q: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt.

s: meal offering has memorial burned on altar (by the priest)
q: the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

s: salt is a salt of the covenant of your God (must not be lacking)
q: You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering.

s: salt is offered with meal offering (all offerings)
q: With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

s: yeast is excluded from altar (not burned)
q: for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

s: first fruits is offered to the LORD (not rising as aroma on altar)
q: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

s: meal offering has ingredient oil (poured on it)
q: He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

s: meal offering has ingredient frankincense (put on it)
q: He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

s: meal offering is offered to the LORD
q: When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD

s: meal offering is brought to Aaron's sons (the priests)
q: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests.

s: meal offering has remainder belonging to Aaron's sons (together with Aaron)
q: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

s: meal offering is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire (the remainder)
q: It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

s: meal offering must not contain yeast
q: No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast;

s: meal offering must not contain honey
q: for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

s: Aaron's sons is a sons of Aaron
q: “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them,

s: high priest is forbidden to go in to any dead body (including for his father or mother)
q: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

s: high priest is forbidden to leave the sanctuary
q: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God

s: marriage restrictions for priests requires high priest to marry virgin of his own people (not a widow, divorced, defiled or prostitute)
q: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

s: physical defects disqualifying priests bars from offering the bread of God (offspring of Aaron with a defect)
q: None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

s: physical defects disqualifying priests includes blindness, lameness, deformity, injuries, hunchback, dwarfism, eye defect, itching disease, scabs, damaged testicles
q: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

s: physical defects disqualifying priests permits eating most holy and holy bread (priest with a defect)
q: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

s: physical defects disqualifying priests bars from approaching veil and altar (priest with a defect)
q: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect

s: the LORD sanctifies sanctuary (sanctuaries)
q: that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

s: Moses speaks to children of Israel (relayed the LORD's instructions)
q: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

s: Aaron's sons is holy (to their God)
q: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God

s: Aaron's sons offer offerings and bread of God (offerings of the LORD made by fire)
q: for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God.

s: Aaron's sons is sanctified by the LORD
q: for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

s: Aaron's sons prohibited from shaving heads or beards, cutting flesh
q: They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

s: marriage restrictions for priests forbids priests marrying prostitute, profane woman, divorced woman
q: They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

s: high priest has on head anointing oil (poured upon his head)
q: He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments,

s: the LORD sanctifies Aaron's sons (priests who follow his commandment)
q: I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

s: holy things of the LORD may not be eaten by priest's daughter (when married to an outsider)
q: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

s: holy things of the LORD may be eaten by priest's daughter (when widowed or divorced, childless, and returned to her father's house)
q: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread

s: holy things of the LORD requires restitution for unwitting eating of holy things (add a fifth of the value and give the holy thing to the priest)
q: If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

s: uncleanness results in cutting off (when a person approaches holy things while unclean)
q: having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me.

s: uncleanness lasts until evening (for one who touches unclean things; bathing required before eating holy things)
q: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

s: offerings are accepted only if without defect (male of bulls, sheep, or goats for burnt offering)
q: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

s: offerings may be offered by strangers (also house of Israel; vows or free will offerings)
q: Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering

s: offerings is burned on altar (offering by fire to the LORD)
q: nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

s: offerings has timing rule seven-day rule for newborn animals (accepted from the eighth day)
q: it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.

s: offerings thanksgiving must be eaten same day (none left until morning)
q: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning.

s: the LORD brought out of egypt children of Israel (to be their God)
q: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God.

s: animals without defect excludes blind, injured, maimed, warty, festering or running-sore animals (unacceptable for offering)
q: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD

s: the LORD makes holy children of Israel
q: I am the LORD who makes you holy,

s: Moses receives speech from the LORD (commanded to relay instructions to Aaron and his sons)
q: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

s: Aaron's sons is related to Aaron (sons)
q: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel

s: Aaron's sons must separate from holy things of the LORD (so as not to profane the LORD's holy name)
q: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name.

s: children of Israel makes holy holy things of the LORD (to the LORD)
q: the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD

s: holy things of the LORD may not be eaten by stranger (non-priestly outsider) (includes foreigner living with priests and hired servant)
q: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

s: holy things of the LORD may be eaten by slave (priest's purchased slave) (also those born in the priest's house)
q: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

s: set feasts of the LORD is a holy convocations (to be proclaimed in their appointed season)
q: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

s: offering of the first fruits sheaf is accompanied by male lamb without defect a year old (burnt offering)
q: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

s: offering of the first fruits sheaf has meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil
q: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil

s: offering of the first fruits sheaf has drink offering wine, fourth part of a hin
q: the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

s: offering of the first fruits sheaf is a statute forever (no eating new grain until it is brought)
q: This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

s: feast of weeks (Pentecost, fifty days after the sheaf) occurs fifty days after the seventh Sabbath (counted from the sheaf offering)
q: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

s: feast of weeks (Pentecost, fifty days after the sheaf) requires two loaves baked with yeast (wave offering of first fruits)
q: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

s: feast of weeks (Pentecost, fifty days after the sheaf) requires seven lambs, one young bull, two rams (burnt offering)
q: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams.

s: feast of weeks (Pentecost, fifty days after the sheaf) is a holy convocation (statute forever, no regular work)
q: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
